newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse closes up, outperforming neigbours.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse closes up, outperforming neigbours.

text.p: 1535 GMT - The Brussels Bel-20 index finished higher on Friday, outperforming most European bourses on the back of a stronger dollar and U.S. figures which indicated that its economy was cooling. Trade to remain moderate until New Year, dealers said.
* Bel-20 .BFX closed up 0.79 percent or 14.89 points at 1,893.27 with a moderate 1.3 billion francs of Belgian shares traded.
* Retailer Delhaize saw a heavy 78,707 shares traded after a newspaper report on Delhaize's 1997 outlook was published. Delhaize closed up 0.27 percent to 1,885 francs.
